en: Build your defense above the clouds.
zh_TW: 於雲海之上，築起你的防線。

en: Extend a road above the clouds and shape your defense.
zh_TW: 延伸雲海上的道路，築起屬於你的防線。

en: Defend the bridge above the clouds.

zh_TW: 01 · 選擇地圖   /   02 · 本局設定   /   03 · 開始
01 · 地圖已選   /   02 · 本局設定   /   03 · 開始

en: Preview options · No gameplay effects yet
zh_TW: 暫定選項 · 目前尚未影響戰局

en: Choose a direction for the new entrance

zh_TW: 選擇一個標示的候選位置
選擇期間無法放置防禦塔

en: No forecast change: candidate routes or whole-unit quotas limit this effect
zh_TW: 分流未變：候選路線或整數配額限制

en: No positive-weight route for the next wave
zh_TW: 下一波沒有正權重路線

en:
Each hit slows movement by about
{single_slow_percent}% for {duration}s.

Repeated hits stack the slow,
approaching a {maximum_slow_percent}% limit.
zh_TW:
每次命中使移速降低約
{single_slow_percent}%，持續 {duration} 秒。

連續命中可疊加減速，
逐漸接近 {maximum_slow_percent}% 上限。

en:
Each Crossfire boosts damage
of other towers within {radius} tiles
by {bonus_percent}%. Soldiers benefit too.

Bonuses from multiple towers add up;
a tower cannot boost itself.
zh_TW:
每座十字火力使 {radius} 格內其他塔
傷害提高 {bonus_percent}%，士兵也受益。

多座塔的加成可以相加，
不強化提供效果的塔本身。

en:
Crossfire deals {damage_multiplier}× damage
to small enemies (+{damage_multiplier_increase}%).

Damage to other sizes is unchanged.
zh_TW:
十字火力對小型敵人
造成 {damage_multiplier} 倍傷害（+{damage_multiplier_increase}%）。

對其他體型的傷害不變。

en:
Mortars can target and damage
flying enemies as well as ground foes.

Damage, range and firing interval
remain unchanged.
zh_TW:
迫擊砲可瞄準並傷害飛行敵人，
也保留原有的對地範圍攻擊。

傷害、射程與攻擊間隔不變。

en:
Every {every} shots, the blast radius
becomes {radius_multiplier}× (+{radius_multiplier_increase}%).

It also damages friendly towers
in the blast, including its own tower,
for {friendly_multiplier_percent}% of the shell damage.
zh_TW:
迫擊砲每第 {every} 發砲彈，
爆炸半徑變為 {radius_multiplier} 倍（+{radius_multiplier_increase}%）。

爆炸也傷害範圍內的友方塔，
包括自身，造成該發傷害的
{friendly_multiplier_percent}%。

en:
Mortar damage becomes {damage_multiplier}×
(+{damage_multiplier_increase}%). Firing interval becomes
{interval_multiplier}×; attack rate falls to
{interval_multiplier_inverse_percent}% of its previous rate.

Shell flight speed becomes
{speed_multiplier_percent}% of its previous speed.
zh_TW:
迫擊砲傷害變為 {damage_multiplier} 倍（+{damage_multiplier_increase}%）。
攻擊間隔變為 {interval_multiplier} 倍，
攻速降至原本的 {interval_multiplier_inverse_percent}%。

砲彈飛行速度降至
原本的 {speed_multiplier_percent}%。

en:
Broadsides patrol back and forth
at {speed} tiles per second.

Their firing areas move with them,
sweeping roads along the patrol.
zh_TW:
舷炮以每秒 {speed} 格往返巡航。

攻擊範圍隨船體一起移動，
掃過巡航沿途的道路；
不改變單次傷害與攻擊間隔。

en:
Every {period}s, fire {shots} extra bursts
with {spacing}s between bursts.

Each side fires at one valid enemy
per burst; the normal attack continues.
zh_TW:
每 {period} 秒觸發 {shots} 輪額外連射，
各輪相隔 {spacing} 秒。

每輪兩側各攻擊一名有效目標；
原本的攻擊仍繼續進行。

en:
Broadside damage becomes
{damage_multiplier}× (+{damage_multiplier_increase}%).

Only the right side may fire;
the left side no longer attacks.
zh_TW:
舷炮傷害變為
{damage_multiplier} 倍（+{damage_multiplier_increase}%）。

只朝右舷開火，
左舷不再攻擊。

en:
Every {period}s, execute one enemy
inside the Sentry's firing area.

Prefers large enemies; bosses
cannot be executed. With no valid
target, waits until one appears.
zh_TW:
哨塔每 {period} 秒可處決
射程內的一名敵人。

優先選擇大型敵人，對首領無效；
沒有有效目標時保留就緒狀態。

en:
Remove the Sentry's Lv.{level_cap} cap.
Upgrades still require matching cards.

Each added level keeps the normal
{growth_damage}× damage and {growth_interval}× interval.
zh_TW:
解除哨塔原本 Lv.{level_cap} 的升級上限，
仍需同種卡牌才能升級。

每升一級仍依原本成長：
傷害 ×{growth_damage}、攻擊間隔 ×{growth_interval}。

en:
Sentry range becomes
{range_multiplier}× (+{range_multiplier_increase}%).

The existing directional shape
is enlarged; damage and interval
remain unchanged.
zh_TW:
哨塔射程變為
{range_multiplier} 倍（+{range_multiplier_increase}%）。

沿原有方向範圍放大，
傷害與攻擊間隔不變。

en:
Ballista bolts pierce enemies
along their flight path.

Bolts travel at {speed} tiles/s through
a {full_width}-tile-wide strip. Each enemy
can be hit once by each bolt.
zh_TW:
弩砲重箭會貫穿沿途敵人。

飛行速度為每秒 {speed} 格，
可命中寬 {full_width} 格內的敵人；
同一發對每名敵人只命中一次。

en:
With no other tower within
{radius} tiles, Ballista damage becomes
{damage_multiplier}× (+{damage_multiplier_increase}%).

Placing another tower within
that radius removes this bonus.
zh_TW:
弩砲周圍 {radius} 格內沒有其他塔時，
傷害變為 {damage_multiplier} 倍（+{damage_multiplier_increase}%）。

範圍內出現其他塔，
這項傷害加成便不再生效。

en:
Each Ballista hit pushes its target
back {distance} tiles along its road.

The enemy resumes moving afterward;
base damage and interval are unchanged.
zh_TW:
弩砲每次命中將敵人
沿原路擊退 {distance} 格。

敵人之後會繼續前進；
基礎傷害與攻擊間隔不變。

en:
Each Barracks deploys
{extra_units} additional soldier: {unit_count} total.

Each soldier retains the normal
damage, health and respawn rules.
zh_TW:
每座兵營增加 {extra_units} 名士兵，
合計部署 {unit_count} 名。

每名士兵的傷害、生命
與重生規則維持原有設定。

en:
Soldiers not engaged in melee
can shoot enemies within {range} tiles.

Base ranged interval: {interval}s.
Uses soldier damage; attack-speed
bonuses also speed up these shots.
zh_TW:
士兵未近戰接敵時，
可射擊 {range} 格內的敵人。

基礎射擊間隔 {interval} 秒，
使用士兵本身的傷害；
攻速加成也會加快射擊。

en:
All towers and soldiers gain
+{bonus_percent}% attack speed per pick.

Stacks add up, up to {max_stacks} picks.
Faster attacks shorten the interval;
movement speed is unchanged.
zh_TW:
每次選擇使所有塔與士兵
攻速提高 {bonus_percent}%。

同遺物加成相加，最多選 {max_stacks} 次；
攻擊間隔隨之縮短，移速不變。

en:
All towers and soldiers deal
+{bonus_percent}% damage per pick.

Stacks add up, up to {max_stacks} picks.
Applies to current and future towers
and their soldiers.
zh_TW:
每次選擇使所有塔與士兵
傷害提高 {bonus_percent}%。

同遺物加成相加，最多選 {max_stacks} 次；
現有與之後建造的塔皆生效。

en:
Immediately gain {amount} gold.

Can be chosen up to {max_stacks} times
per run. Each pick pays once;
this is not income every wave.
zh_TW:
立即獲得 {amount} 金幣。

每局最多選 {max_stacks} 次，
每次只發放一次，
不會在每波重複發放。

en:
After {paid_rerolls} paid shop rerolls,
the next reroll is free.

Then the cycle starts over. Progress
carries across waves and starts
when this relic is acquired.
Can be acquired once per run.
zh_TW:
每付費刷新 {paid_rerolls} 次商店，
下一次刷新免費。

免費刷新後重新累積，
進度跨波次保留，取得後才開始計次。
每局只能取得一次。

en: Learn camera controls and reshape roads with cards before upgrading your first tower.
zh_TW: 練習鏡頭操作、用卡牌改變道路，再升級你的第一座塔。
左鍵拖曳  /  滾輪  /  右鍵環繞
防線紀錄 / 作戰完成
防線紀錄 / 作戰結束

en:
Left-drag to pan the view.
Use the wheel to zoom.
Right-drag around screen center
to rotate. Try each once.
zh_TW:
按住左鍵拖曳，平移視角。
滾動滾輪，調整遠近。
按住右鍵繞畫面中心拖曳，
旋轉視角。請各試一次。
{pan} 平移　{zoom} 縮放　{orbit} 旋轉

en:
Select the {first_tower} card.
Match the translucent hologram.
The tower blocks the old road;
its card adds a way around it.
zh_TW:
選擇{first_tower}卡。
依半透明指示的方向放置。
塔會占住原路，
附帶道路可讓敵人繞行。

en:
Select the {second_tower} card.
Press R or right-click to rotate.
Match the pulsing hologram
and place your second tower.
zh_TW:
選擇{second_tower}卡。
按 R 或單擊右鍵旋轉，
對齊半透明指示後放置。
讓道路繞過第二座塔。

en:
Place your last {third_tower}.
Choose a position and direction.
Keep the entrance connected
to the goal.
zh_TW:
最後一張{third_tower}可自由放置。
挑選位置與方向，
保持入口到終點連通。

en:
Ready?
Click Start next wave
above the entrance.
zh_TW:
準備好了嗎？
點入口上方的
「開始下一波」。

en:
Watch your towers defend.
After the wave ends,
visit the shop to reinforce.
zh_TW:
觀察防禦塔如何守住道路。
這一波結束後，
再到商店補強。

en:
Open the lower-right shop.
Buy the {upgrade_tower} card.
Use it to upgrade the matching
tower already on the map.
zh_TW:
點開右下角商店，
購買{upgrade_tower}卡。
用它升級地圖上的同種塔。

en:
Place the {upgrade_tower} card
on your existing {upgrade_tower}
to upgrade it to Lv.2.
No extra roads or coins needed.
zh_TW:
把剛買的{upgrade_tower}卡，
放到原本的{upgrade_tower}上，
升級至 Lv.2。
升級不會增加道路或額外花費。

en:
Open the shop.
Click its lower-right reroll card
to refresh the offers.
Rerolling costs gold.
zh_TW:
點開商店，
再點右下角的刷新牌。
刷新商品會花費金幣。

en:
Buy {new_tower} from the shop.
Try a tower that was not
in your starting hand.
zh_TW:
購買刷新後的{new_tower}卡，
擴充初始手牌以外的塔種。

en:
The guided steps are complete!
Build and shop freely.
Defend all three waves
to finish the level.
zh_TW:
基本操作練習完成！
接下來可以自由建造，
也能購買與升級。
守完全部三波即可通關。

en:
All three waves cleared!
The next level is now unlocked.
Continue to choose your next battlefield.
zh_TW:
三波防守完成！
後續關卡已解鎖。
繼續選擇下一個戰場吧。

en: Match the highlighted card and hologram position and direction.
zh_TW: 請依提示選牌，並配合半透明指示的位置與方向。

en: Complete the current tutorial step first.
zh_TW: 請先完成目前的教學步驟。

en: Choose an entry to see its details.
Boss: a leak ends the run

Fires arrows that damage
a single enemy.
zh_TW:
射出箭矢，
對單一敵人造成傷害。
單體攻擊|只打前方範圍

en:
Fires heavy bolts along a long line.
Slow shots deal powerful damage.
zh_TW:
沿長直線射出重箭，
射速慢但威力強。

en:
Fires from both broadsides,
damaging enemies on either side.
zh_TW:
側舷開火，
對兩側敵人造成傷害。
六門獨立火砲|只打側舷

en:
Releases rapid shockwaves
that strike all enemies in range.
zh_TW:
快速釋放衝擊波，
打擊範圍內的所有敵人。

en:
Fires shells that deal area damage
to ground enemies.
zh_TW:
發射砲彈，對地面敵人
造成範圍傷害。
範圍傷害|無法攻擊飛行敵人

en:
Deploys two soldiers to block enemies
on the road and fight in melee.
zh_TW:
部署兩名友軍在道路上
攔截敵人並近戰。

en: Blocks enemies|Soldiers respawn after 5s|Cannot block flying enemies
zh_TW: 攔截敵人|友軍陣亡 5 秒後重生|無法攔截飛行敵人

en: Frontline infantry, the backbone of the advancing force.
zh_TW: 沿道路推進的前線步兵，是敵軍隊伍的中堅。

en: A lightly equipped runner that slips through gaps in the defense.
zh_TW: 輕裝斥候善於穿過防線空隙，迅速向終點推進。

en: An armored warrior that advances slowly toward the goal.
zh_TW: 沉重裝甲掩護著緩慢推進的戰士。

en: Small creatures that surge down the same road in packs.
zh_TW: 成群奔竄的小型敵人，沿同一條道路湧向防線。

en: A shield bearer that draws fire away from nearby allies.
zh_TW: 舉盾前行的守衛，以自身掩護周圍的隊伍。

en: A marching spellcaster that restores nearby wounded allies.
zh_TW: 隨軍行進的施法者，讓附近受傷的同伴再次站穩腳步。

en: A winged creature that follows the attack road from above.
zh_TW: 盤旋於道路上方的飛獸，仍沿進攻路線接近終點。

en: A scout that takes advantage of newly completed roads.
zh_TW: 尋找新通路的偵查兵，會利用最近接通的道路。

en: A saboteur that briefly disables nearby defenses.
zh_TW: 潛入火線的破壞者，會讓附近的防禦塔短暫失去作用。

en: A siege beast whose arrival at the goal breaks the defense.
zh_TW: 向終點緩慢逼近的攻城巨獸，足以撕開整條防線。

en: An enemy advancing along the road.
zh_TW: 沿道路接近防線的敵軍。

en: Heals allies within 2.5 tiles for 18 every 3 seconds
zh_TW: 每 3 秒治療 2.5 格內友軍 18 生命。

en: Every 6 seconds targets a tower within 3 tiles, winds up for 1 second, then disables it for 2.5 seconds. source death removes its effect.
zh_TW: 每 6 秒選附近 3 格內一塔，前搖 1 秒後癱瘓 2.5 秒。死亡即解除。

en: Shielded heavy infantry. Prefers heavily defended routes.
zh_TW: 帶護盾的重裝步兵，偏好火力密集的路線。

en: Small and fast. Prefers lightly defended routes.
zh_TW: 體型小、腳程快，偏好防守薄弱的路線。

en: Low health. Cohorts of five share a route; each rat takes damage separately.
zh_TW: 低生命，每群 5 隻共用路線，個別承受傷害。

en: Charges for 1.2s, then disables up to two towers within 3 tiles for 3s; 8s cooldown after casting or cancellation. Follows its fixed road; slow and interception apply. Immune to Hunting execution. Reaching the goal ends the run.
zh_TW:
蓄力 1.2 秒後，癱瘓 3 格內最多兩座塔 3 秒；施放或取消後冷卻 8 秒。
可被減速與攔截。無法被處決；抵達終點即失敗。

en: Follows the roads most allies take. Draws eligible single-target fire within 3.5 tiles; priority, distance, then spawn order break ties.
zh_TW: 跟著多數友軍走的道路。吸引3.5 格內的單體火力。

en: Uses the newest surviving complete routes. Routes established in the same wave can share traffic.
zh_TW: 只走最新一批仍有效的完整道路

en: Standard infantry, spread evenly across the routes.
zh_TW: 標準步兵，平均分散在各條路線。

en: Flies above roads; cannot be intercepted. Mortars need Air Strike to target or damage it. Other shooting towers can attack it.
zh_TW: 沿道路上方飛行，無法被兵營攔截。不受地面攻擊影響

en:
Game speed: %d×
Click / Tab to cycle 1× / 2× / 4×.
zh_TW:
遊戲速度：%d 倍
點擊／Tab 切換 1／2／4 倍速。
暫停遊戲並開啟選單 · Esc

en:
Defense integrity: %d / %d
Enemies reaching the goal damage the defense. A siege behemoth reaching it ends the run.
zh_TW:
防線生命：%d / %d
敵人抵達終點會損傷防線；攻城巨獸抵達即失敗。
%d 名士兵 · 每名生命 %s · 重生 %s 秒

en: Ends the run if it reaches the base

Choose a relic
After %s · choose one of three relics.
zh_TW:
遺物選擇
完成 %s 後，從三件遺物選擇一件。

%s · 第 %d 波（全局 %d / %d）
%s · %d 名敵軍 · 完成獎勵 %d 金幣

en: Every %s s, restores %s HP to allies within %s tiles, including itself, without exceeding their maximum HP.
zh_TW: 每 %s 秒為 %s 格內的友軍（包括自己）恢復 %s 生命，不超過生命上限。

en: After a %s s windup, disables up to %d nearby towers within %s tiles for %s s. Cooldown after casting or cancellation: %s s. Its disables end when it dies or leaves.
zh_TW: 蓄力 %s 秒後，使 %s 格內最多 %d 座附近防禦塔癱瘓 %s 秒；施放或取消後冷卻 %s 秒。來源死亡或離場便解除癱瘓。

en: Draws eligible single-target attacks from towers within %s tiles. Does not redirect attacks that hit the whole area.
zh_TW: 吸引 %s 格內防禦塔可命中的單體攻擊，不會轉移整片範圍攻擊。

en: Leaves a road trail that speeds up other ground enemies by %s%% while on it and for %s s after leaving. It does not boost itself; the trail disappears at wave end.
zh_TW: 沿路留下痕跡，使其他地面敵軍移速提高 %s%%，離開後再持續 %s 秒。不強化自己，痕跡在波次結束時消失。

en: Cannot be intercepted by soldiers. Mortars require Air Strike to hit it; other shooting towers can attack it.
zh_TW: 不能被士兵攔截。迫擊砲需要空襲遺物才能命中，其他射擊塔仍可攻擊。

en: Can be slowed and intercepted, but Hunting cannot execute it. Reaching the goal ends the run immediately.
zh_TW: 可被減速與攔截，但不能被狩獵處決；抵達終點便立即戰敗。
新敵軍發現 · %d 則未讀

en: Only follows the shortest passable roads to the goal.
zh_TW: 只走能抵達終點的最短道路。

en: It still follows roads from above, rather than flying directly across gaps.
zh_TW: 即使在空中，也沿道路前進。

en: Only takes the newest complete routes that still reach the goal. Routes connected in the same wave can share the scouts; a newly built dead end does not attract them.
zh_TW: 只走新接通的路線，要注意剛建成的道路。

en: Tends to use the roads most other enemies will take, so it often travels with the main force. It does not change roads mid-march to chase an ally.
zh_TW: 喜歡走其他敵軍多數會經過的道路，因此常與主力隊伍同路。

en: Tends to avoid the roads most other enemies will take, using quieter routes instead.
zh_TW: 傾向避開其他敵軍多數會經過的道路，改走較少敵軍使用的路線。

en: Seeks roads near clusters of defense towers. It may take a longer route to approach more towers instead of rushing along the shortest road.
zh_TW: 熱愛危險，偏好靠近防禦塔密集處的道路，可能繞較長的路接近更多塔。

en: Usually chooses roads covered by less tower fire and favors shorter routes when other conditions are similar. It may detour around a heavily defended road.
zh_TW: 喜歡走較少防禦塔火力覆蓋的道路，條件相近時也偏向較短路線。

en: Usually heads into roads covered by more tower fire. It may take a longer route through a strong defense instead of avoiding it.
zh_TW: 偏好較多防禦塔火力覆蓋的道路。
